scope: Reviewed application control families across the HRO Control Tower, API, unified context manager and Employee Vault. Cost Explorer figures are estimates, not security or outcome assurance. This is a code-and-content inventory, not a production configuration audit, penetration test or certification.

status_definitions.Implemented: An application control exists; this does not establish live effectiveness.
status_definitions.Configuration required: The framework exists, but approved policies, authority, providers or evidence are prerequisites.
status_definitions.Roadmap: The additional capability described is not established as a completed feature in this review.
status_definitions.Deployment evidence not verified: A deployment, contractual or operational fact requiring separate evidence; not a claim of absence.

controls.name: Authenticated operational access
controls.mechanism: Signed-in identity is required for operational API access; provider callbacks have separate verification boundaries.
controls.safe_behavior: Unauthorized access is rejected.
controls.limitation: Authentication does not grant organization, case or specialist authority.
controls.risk_addressed: Unauthorized record access, privilege escalation or unverified professional authority.
controls.published_effectiveness_rate: Not asserted; see the metric register for defined available evidence and roadmap measurements.

controls.name: Organization and case isolation
controls.mechanism: Application-owned organizations and subject scopes constrain access to client records.
controls.safe_behavior: Cross-scope requests are denied.
controls.limitation: Tenant membership alone is not permission for every case or record.
controls.risk_addressed: Unauthorized record access, privilege escalation or unverified professional authority.
controls.published_effectiveness_rate: Not asserted; see the metric register for defined available evidence and roadmap measurements.

controls.name: Group, field and tool permissions
controls.mechanism: Access groups and scoped permissions govern eligible flows, fields and tools.
controls.safe_behavior: Disallowed reads or actions are blocked.
controls.limitation: Coverage must be checked for each new endpoint and tool.
controls.risk_addressed: Unauthorized record access, privilege escalation or unverified professional authority.
controls.published_effectiveness_rate: Not asserted; see the metric register for defined available evidence and roadmap measurements.

controls.name: Temporary access and lifecycle fencing
controls.mechanism: Time-bounded grants and membership lifecycle state are evaluated against current access.
controls.safe_behavior: Expired or revoked grants cannot authorize subsequent work.
controls.limitation: Race-sensitive flows need ongoing regression evidence; expiry is not a historical audit rewrite.
controls.risk_addressed: Unauthorized record access, privilege escalation or unverified professional authority.
controls.published_effectiveness_rate: Not asserted; see the metric register for defined available evidence and roadmap measurements.

controls.name: Verified specialist authority
controls.mechanism: Professional governance authority is distinct from tenant administration and mailbox personas.
controls.safe_behavior: Missing or unverified authority blocks specialist actions.
controls.limitation: Authority must be established through the applicable approval process.
controls.risk_addressed: Unauthorized record access, privilege escalation or unverified professional authority.
controls.published_effectiveness_rate: Not asserted; see the metric register for defined available evidence and roadmap measurements.

controls.name: Versioned approvals and policies
controls.mechanism: Consequential work uses approved policy revisions and evidence-bound review rather than unreviewed drafts.
controls.safe_behavior: Changed evidence or missing approvals require review.
controls.limitation: A new policy cannot prove the rationale of an older decision.
controls.risk_addressed: Unauthorized record access, privilege escalation or unverified professional authority.
controls.published_effectiveness_rate: Not asserted; see the metric register for defined available evidence and roadmap measurements.

controls.name: Registered agent identity
controls.mechanism: Agent identity and version are resolved against server-side registration and permitted execution scope.
controls.safe_behavior: Unknown or unauthorized executors are rejected.
controls.limitation: Client-supplied role or permission claims are not authority.
controls.risk_addressed: Unauthorized record access, privilege escalation or unverified professional authority.
controls.published_effectiveness_rate: Not asserted; see the metric register for defined available evidence and roadmap measurements.

controls.name: Candidate-link access lifecycle
controls.mechanism: Candidate portal credentials and access records are scoped and expire; eligible metadata has a separate cleanup lifecycle.
controls.safe_behavior: Invalid or expired links cannot authorize portal operations.
controls.limitation: Portal access is not full Control Tower access; active links are not deleted just for metadata age.
controls.risk_addressed: Unauthorized record access, privilege escalation or unverified professional authority.
controls.published_effectiveness_rate: Not asserted; see the metric register for defined available evidence and roadmap measurements.

controls.name: Hashed portal credentials and exchange throttling
controls.mechanism: Candidate token/session secrets are hashed for lookup; bounded failure records and cooldowns constrain exchange attempts.
controls.safe_behavior: Repeated invalid exchange attempts are throttled; expired or revoked link/session bindings fail.
controls.limitation: These controls protect the candidate portal, not every authentication provider or application endpoint.
controls.risk_addressed: Unauthorized record access, privilege escalation or unverified professional authority.
controls.published_effectiveness_rate: Not asserted; see the metric register for defined available evidence and roadmap measurements.

controls.name: Signed webhook verification
controls.mechanism: Twilio callbacks are signature-validated; voice callbacks also bind to the expected call identity.
controls.safe_behavior: Forged callbacks are rejected before influencing state.
controls.limitation: Applies to configured channel boundaries; it is not a universal vendor identity guarantee.
controls.risk_addressed: Forged, misrouted, duplicated or runaway external communication.
controls.published_effectiveness_rate: Not asserted; see the metric register for defined available evidence and roadmap measurements.

controls.name: Trusted status senders
controls.mechanism: Configured sender allowlists gate external status-email processing; an unset list trusts nobody.
controls.safe_behavior: Untrusted status messages do not change checks.
controls.limitation: A trusted sender still needs the applicable case binding and evidence checks.
controls.risk_addressed: Forged, misrouted, duplicated or runaway external communication.
controls.published_effectiveness_rate: Not asserted; see the metric register for defined available evidence and roadmap measurements.

controls.name: Case binding and replay protection
controls.mechanism: Inbound communication is subject-bound, with provider-message deduplication and self-echo protection.
controls.safe_behavior: Unmatched, ambiguous or duplicate messages do not drive new effects.
controls.limitation: Sender identity alone cannot establish tenant or specialist authority.
controls.risk_addressed: Forged, misrouted, duplicated or runaway external communication.
controls.published_effectiveness_rate: Not asserted; see the metric register for defined available evidence and roadmap measurements.

controls.name: Recipient and volunteer restrictions
controls.mechanism: External messages and calls require authorized recipients; demo volunteer authorization is explicit.
controls.safe_behavior: Unauthorized delivery is blocked or recorded as logged-only.
controls.limitation: A delivery record is not proof of stakeholder approval or completed employment work.
controls.risk_addressed: Forged, misrouted, duplicated or runaway external communication.
controls.published_effectiveness_rate: Not asserted; see the metric register for defined available evidence and roadmap measurements.

controls.name: Send and call caps
controls.mechanism: Communication limits and voice-turn serialization constrain runaway activity and replays.
controls.safe_behavior: Excess or overlapping work is rate-limited, held or safely ended.
controls.limitation: These are scoped controls, not evidence of an enterprise-wide denial-of-service guarantee.
controls.risk_addressed: Forged, misrouted, duplicated or runaway external communication.
controls.published_effectiveness_rate: Not asserted; see the metric register for defined available evidence and roadmap measurements.

controls.name: Bounded voice interaction
controls.mechanism: Voice accepts fixed structured decisions with bounded speech, output and conversation turns.
controls.safe_behavior: Unsafe or invalid output routes to a human callback or ends safely.
controls.limitation: Successful voice exchange does not authorize record changes or professional commitments.
controls.risk_addressed: Forged, misrouted, duplicated or runaway external communication.
controls.published_effectiveness_rate: Not asserted; see the metric register for defined available evidence and roadmap measurements.

controls.name: Sensitive collection and disclosure policy
controls.mechanism: Approved, versioned policies govern sensitive collection and disclosure at the relevant boundary.
controls.safe_behavior: Unknown classification or missing approval can block handling.
controls.limitation: Administrative access does not establish a lawful processing basis.
controls.risk_addressed: Unauthorized sensitive disclosure, excessive retention or unsafe deletion.
controls.published_effectiveness_rate: Not asserted; see the metric register for defined available evidence and roadmap measurements.

controls.name: Opaque-content confidentiality
controls.mechanism: Free text and opaque subject material are not presumed public or harmless.
controls.safe_behavior: Unclassified sensitive material is withheld from unauthorized use.
controls.limitation: Each new content type needs conservative classification and disclosure coverage.
controls.risk_addressed: Unauthorized sensitive disclosure, excessive retention or unsafe deletion.
controls.published_effectiveness_rate: Not asserted; see the metric register for defined available evidence and roadmap measurements.

controls.name: Minimized and masked evidence
controls.mechanism: Domain builders restrict model evidence; communication audit paths mask contacts and bound input snippets.
controls.safe_behavior: Inputs are sanitized or rejected at relevant boundaries.
controls.limitation: Scoped masking is not proof that all stored records are anonymous.
controls.risk_addressed: Unauthorized sensitive disclosure, excessive retention or unsafe deletion.
controls.published_effectiveness_rate: Not asserted; see the metric register for defined available evidence and roadmap measurements.

controls.name: Retention, deletion and legal holds
controls.mechanism: Sensitive-record cleanup uses reviewed policy and hold-aware lifecycle controls.
controls.safe_behavior: Active holds or unsafe lifecycle state prevent eligible cleanup.
controls.limitation: Retention periods are approved by the client; no universal statutory period is invented.
controls.risk_addressed: Unauthorized sensitive disclosure, excessive retention or unsafe deletion.
controls.published_effectiveness_rate: Not asserted; see the metric register for defined available evidence and roadmap measurements.

controls.name: Metadata-only unified context
controls.mechanism: Context history records scope, identifiers, statuses and bounded metrics, not prompts, answers or documents.
controls.safe_behavior: Cross-tenant or cross-actor context inheritance is rejected.
controls.limitation: Business records and protected audit evidence have separate retention rules.
controls.risk_addressed: Unauthorized sensitive disclosure, excessive retention or unsafe deletion.
controls.published_effectiveness_rate: Not asserted; see the metric register for defined available evidence and roadmap measurements.

controls.name: Safe context-history pruning
controls.mechanism: Approved rules govern bounded cleanup of eligible complete chains while preserving unsafe or unfinished chains.
controls.safe_behavior: Holds, unfinished or unsafe chains prevent pruning.
controls.limitation: A display window is not retention; pruning is not deletion of all business evidence.
controls.risk_addressed: Unauthorized sensitive disclosure, excessive retention or unsafe deletion.
controls.published_effectiveness_rate: Not asserted; see the metric register for defined available evidence and roadmap measurements.

controls.name: Restricted aggregate analytics
controls.mechanism: Analytics bounds disclosure and uses a local deterministic narrative instead of sending opaque cohort content to a model.
controls.safe_behavior: Unauthorized sensitive forecasts are withheld.
controls.limitation: A privacy badge or threshold label is not proof of full differential privacy or safe release of every cohort.
controls.risk_addressed: Unauthorized sensitive disclosure, excessive retention or unsafe deletion.
controls.published_effectiveness_rate: Not asserted; see the metric register for defined available evidence and roadmap measurements.

controls.name: Private bounded upload lifecycle
controls.mechanism: Scoped upload reservations and bounded file handling track completion and interrupted writes.
controls.safe_behavior: Incomplete or invalid writes cannot become accepted evidence.
controls.limitation: An upload signature alone does not bind all size/type restrictions.
controls.risk_addressed: Unsafe, forged, stale or unconsented document reuse.
controls.published_effectiveness_rate: Not asserted; see the metric register for defined available evidence and roadmap measurements.

controls.name: Malware quarantine and evidence gates
controls.mechanism: Malware state and current evidence gates govern whether a document may be used for readiness.
controls.safe_behavior: Quarantined or unavailable safety evidence cannot be bypassed by authenticity claims.
controls.limitation: Live scan results require a configured scanner; clean files can still be forged.
controls.risk_addressed: Unsafe, forged, stale or unconsented document reuse.
controls.published_effectiveness_rate: Not asserted; see the metric register for defined available evidence and roadmap measurements.

controls.name: Document validation versus authenticity
controls.mechanism: Local file validation is distinguished from source-backed verification and human review.
controls.safe_behavior: Unavailable, uncertain or adverse results require review.
controls.limitation: Readable text, matching fields or an AI plausibility score do not authenticate a document.
controls.risk_addressed: Unsafe, forged, stale or unconsented document reuse.
controls.published_effectiveness_rate: Not asserted; see the metric register for defined available evidence and roadmap measurements.

controls.name: Independent Employee Vault ownership
controls.mechanism: Employee profiles are separately owned; registration does not confer employer or reviewer roles.
controls.safe_behavior: Other users cannot act as the employee merely through organization membership.
controls.limitation: A personal Vault account is not proof of employer identity binding.
controls.risk_addressed: Unsafe, forged, stale or unconsented document reuse.
controls.published_effectiveness_rate: Not asserted; see the metric register for defined available evidence and roadmap measurements.

controls.name: Signed source and revision binding
controls.mechanism: Approved issuer keys verify signed results bound to profile, jurisdiction, document revision and content digest.
controls.safe_behavior: Changed, expired or mismatched bindings cannot establish current reuse.
controls.limitation: Cryptography proves an accepted issuer's statement, not that every issuer or document type is supported.
controls.risk_addressed: Unsafe, forged, stale or unconsented document reuse.
controls.published_effectiveness_rate: Not asserted; see the metric register for defined available evidence and roadmap measurements.

controls.name: Consent, complete requirements and revocation
controls.mechanism: Reuse requires current employee consent, employer-case binding and all required eligible checks.
controls.safe_behavior: Partial verification, expired consent or revoked sharing cannot satisfy full reuse.
controls.limitation: Revocation stops future sharing; it does not undo earlier lawful disclosures.
controls.risk_addressed: Unsafe, forged, stale or unconsented document reuse.
controls.published_effectiveness_rate: Not asserted; see the metric register for defined available evidence and roadmap measurements.

controls.name: Private opt-in expiry notices
controls.mechanism: Employee-owned in-app notices warn of eligible verification or sharing expiry under a separate preference.
controls.safe_behavior: Disabled, stale or no-longer-eligible notices are not disclosed.
controls.limitation: Notices do not renew checks, extend consent or imply verified email delivery.
controls.risk_addressed: Unsafe, forged, stale or unconsented document reuse.
controls.published_effectiveness_rate: Not asserted; see the metric register for defined available evidence and roadmap measurements.

controls.name: Approved extractive policy answers
controls.mechanism: The assistant selects an authorized approved extract with a constrained identifier and exact quotation validation.
controls.safe_behavior: Insufficient, conflicting or injected content can prevent an answer.
controls.limitation: Exact quote validity is not a measured end-to-end answer-correctness guarantee.
controls.risk_addressed: Unsupported, manipulated or harmful AI-supported answers and actions.
controls.published_effectiveness_rate: Not asserted; see the metric register for defined available evidence and roadmap measurements.

controls.name: Prompt-injection evidence fencing
controls.mechanism: Inbound text and speech are treated as evidence, with structured output and restricted state decisions.
controls.safe_behavior: Instruction-like, contradictory or risky content is escalated instead of accepted as authority.
controls.limitation: Defense is layered risk reduction, not proof that every possible injection is defeated.
controls.risk_addressed: Unsupported, manipulated or harmful AI-supported answers and actions.
controls.published_effectiveness_rate: Not asserted; see the metric register for defined available evidence and roadmap measurements.

controls.name: Sensitive-topic human handoff
controls.mechanism: Deterministic sensitive-topic gates suppress automated AI replies and request human review.
controls.safe_behavior: Sensitive questions receive a holding or escalation path.
controls.limitation: Human review itself does not guarantee correctness or fairness.
controls.risk_addressed: Unsupported, manipulated or harmful AI-supported answers and actions.
controls.published_effectiveness_rate: Not asserted; see the metric register for defined available evidence and roadmap measurements.

controls.name: No automated adverse employment decisions
controls.mechanism: Adverse background-check or core-data exceptions pause orchestration for appropriate human approval.
controls.safe_behavior: Automation cannot simply reject or clear the case from model output.
controls.limitation: Review quality and lawful criteria still require domain governance.
controls.risk_addressed: Unsupported, manipulated or harmful AI-supported answers and actions.
controls.published_effectiveness_rate: Not asserted; see the metric register for defined available evidence and roadmap measurements.

controls.name: Strict AI request budgets
controls.mechanism: Exact registered model payloads receive conservative input-size and output-allocation checks.
controls.safe_behavior: Oversized or invalid requests are rejected without silently truncating mandatory evidence.
controls.limitation: Input bytes are a conservative token bound; output allocation is not actual token usage.
controls.risk_addressed: Unsupported, manipulated or harmful AI-supported answers and actions.
controls.published_effectiveness_rate: Not asserted; see the metric register for defined available evidence and roadmap measurements.

controls.name: Recorded-evidence explanations
controls.mechanism: Case explanations remain read-only and distinguish recorded evidence from hidden model reasoning or invented historical rationale.
controls.safe_behavior: Missing historical evidence cannot be replaced by a confident explanation.
controls.limitation: Present policy does not establish why an earlier decision occurred.
controls.risk_addressed: Unsupported, manipulated or harmful AI-supported answers and actions.
controls.published_effectiveness_rate: Not asserted; see the metric register for defined available evidence and roadmap measurements.

controls.name: Fresh citation and answer disclosure
controls.mechanism: Policy answers recheck current source, publication, applicability and disclosure authorization after model selection and at citation access.
controls.safe_behavior: Changed or no-longer-authorized source material cannot be disclosed as a current supported answer.
controls.limitation: The check guards freshness and authority; it is not a semantic accuracy score.
controls.risk_addressed: Unsupported, manipulated or harmful AI-supported answers and actions.
controls.published_effectiveness_rate: Not asserted; see the metric register for defined available evidence and roadmap measurements.

groups.title: Agent execution and unified context harness

controls.name: Scoped transaction continuity
controls.mechanism: Organization, subject, correlation, parent attempt, initiator and executor/version define execution continuity.
controls.safe_behavior: Invalid tenant, actor, executor or parent scope is rejected.
controls.limitation: The manager is continuity metadata, not authority, business evidence or a second workflow engine.
controls.risk_addressed: Cross-scope execution, stale authority or duplicated/ambiguous remote effects.
controls.published_effectiveness_rate: Not asserted; see the metric register for defined available evidence and roadmap measurements.

controls.name: Fresh dispatch eligibility
controls.mechanism: Final dispatch gates recheck authority, holds, policy and evidence at the consequential action boundary.
controls.safe_behavior: Stale or withdrawn prerequisites block effects.
controls.limitation: A preliminary status read or older successful log is not permission to act now.
controls.risk_addressed: Cross-scope execution, stale authority or duplicated/ambiguous remote effects.
controls.published_effectiveness_rate: Not asserted; see the metric register for defined available evidence and roadmap measurements.

controls.name: Durable effect journal
controls.mechanism: Remote effects use durable claims and stable logical-operation identity with provider idempotency where supported.
controls.safe_behavior: Ambiguous non-idempotent outcomes stop for reconciliation rather than blind redispatch.
controls.limitation: Database fencing cannot substitute for a provider's idempotency contract.
controls.risk_addressed: Cross-scope execution, stale authority or duplicated/ambiguous remote effects.
controls.published_effectiveness_rate: Not asserted; see the metric register for defined available evidence and roadmap measurements.

controls.name: Recovery and concurrency fencing
controls.mechanism: Checkpoints, owner-fenced claims and conditional completion guard resumed or simultaneous work.
controls.safe_behavior: Stale owners cannot finalize newly claimed work.
controls.limitation: Unfinished attempts are not automatically business failures or completed outcomes.
controls.risk_addressed: Cross-scope execution, stale authority or duplicated/ambiguous remote effects.
controls.published_effectiveness_rate: Not asserted; see the metric register for defined available evidence and roadmap measurements.

controls.name: History disclosure permission
controls.mechanism: Personal and separately authorized operator history use live scoped checks, filters and older-page navigation.
controls.safe_behavior: Unauthorized history disclosure is denied.
controls.limitation: History access is not a grant to retry actions; shared demo personas do not establish personal attribution.
controls.risk_addressed: Cross-scope execution, stale authority or duplicated/ambiguous remote effects.
controls.published_effectiveness_rate: Not asserted; see the metric register for defined available evidence and roadmap measurements.

controls.name: Detached background identity
controls.mechanism: Background work must establish its own tenant/executor context instead of inheriting a heartbeat caller's authority.
controls.safe_behavior: Cross-actor or cross-tenant continuation cannot borrow ambient identity.
controls.limitation: Worker scheduling and availability require separate operational assurance.
controls.risk_addressed: Cross-scope execution, stale authority or duplicated/ambiguous remote effects.
controls.published_effectiveness_rate: Not asserted; see the metric register for defined available evidence and roadmap measurements.

controls.name: Protected append-only audit
controls.mechanism: Protected audit records and tamper-evident chain verification retain consequential action evidence.
controls.safe_behavior: Detected inconsistency prevents treating the chain as verified.
controls.limitation: A privileged rewrite of a local chain requires independent evidence to detect.
controls.risk_addressed: Undetected tampering, unready regulated launch or silent loss of safety services.
controls.published_effectiveness_rate: Not asserted; see the metric register for defined available evidence and roadmap measurements.

controls.name: Independent audit anchoring
controls.mechanism: An approved external provider verifies generation-bound checkpoints and independent archive, restore and hold-drill receipts.
controls.safe_behavior: Missing, stale or mismatched protection evidence blocks readiness.
controls.limitation: Framework existence is not proof that a client's live provider is connected; protection added today does not certify earlier records.
controls.risk_addressed: Undetected tampering, unready regulated launch or silent loss of safety services.
controls.published_effectiveness_rate: Not asserted; see the metric register for defined available evidence and roadmap measurements.

controls.name: Opt-in regulated launch guard
controls.mechanism: Explicitly selected regulated tenants must satisfy protected audit and external archive readiness before startup proceeds.
controls.safe_behavior: Unverifiable or unready selected tenants block regulated production startup.
controls.limitation: Not every tenant or deployment automatically has this opt-in safeguard enabled.
controls.risk_addressed: Undetected tampering, unready regulated launch or silent loss of safety services.
controls.published_effectiveness_rate: Not asserted; see the metric register for defined available evidence and roadmap measurements.

controls.name: Scanner outage monitoring
controls.mechanism: Scanner health and durable outage handling support explicit degraded-state visibility and alerts.
controls.safe_behavior: Unavailable safety evidence remains unavailable instead of becoming a clean scan.
controls.limitation: Alerts need configured channels and delivery evidence; monitoring is not uptime certification.
controls.risk_addressed: Undetected tampering, unready regulated launch or silent loss of safety services.
controls.published_effectiveness_rate: Not asserted; see the metric register for defined available evidence and roadmap measurements.

controls.name: Guardrail catalogue and interventions
controls.mechanism: The Guardrails screen identifies enforcement mechanisms, evidence pointers and recorded blocked, rejected or escalated activity.
controls.safe_behavior: Recording is bounded against abuse; enforcement remains distinct from display counts.
controls.limitation: The 13 communication guardrails are a subset of this inventory; counts are not exhaustive attack-volume estimates.
controls.risk_addressed: Mistaking limited test, synthetic or demo evidence for live assurance.
controls.published_effectiveness_rate: Not asserted; see the metric register for defined available evidence and roadmap measurements.

controls.name: Controlled security drill
controls.mechanism: Synthetic attack scenarios exercise selected real enforcement boundaries with protected delivery-deny conditions.
controls.safe_behavior: Unexpected live authorization or delivery aborts the drill.
controls.limitation: A scenario pass is not a comprehensive penetration test or fresh independent audit.
controls.risk_addressed: Mistaking limited test, synthetic or demo evidence for live assurance.
controls.published_effectiveness_rate: Not asserted; see the metric register for defined available evidence and roadmap measurements.

controls.name: UAT evidence and isolated fixtures
controls.mechanism: UAT distinguishes observed workflow evidence, run-owned fixtures, blocked steps and manual work.
controls.safe_behavior: Initialization or evidence gaps do not become a manual bypass to a pass.
controls.limitation: Synthetic initialization or simulated exchange does not establish real provider execution.
controls.risk_addressed: Mistaking limited test, synthetic or demo evidence for live assurance.
controls.published_effectiveness_rate: Not asserted; see the metric register for defined available evidence and roadmap measurements.

controls.name: Regression and demo boundaries
controls.mechanism: Unit, integration and browser checks plus controlled demonstrations support change assurance.
controls.safe_behavior: Tests should exercise denial, recovery, scope changes and uncertainty as well as success.
controls.limitation: Tests found in source are not a claim that the latest suite has passed; volunteer delivery still needs authorization.
controls.risk_addressed: Mistaking limited test, synthetic or demo evidence for live assurance.
controls.published_effectiveness_rate: Not asserted; see the metric register for defined available evidence and roadmap measurements.

metrics.title: Recorded guardrail interventions
metrics.definition: Recorded events by guardrail/action and the screen's summed count.
metrics.limitation: Bounded recording means this is not total attack volume; a prevention rate needs a valid attempted-action denominator.

metrics.title: Security-drill outcomes
metrics.definition: Step outcomes from the scenarios in the executed drill.
metrics.limitation: Identify scope and run date; no fresh drill was run for this document.

metrics.title: Human-review indicator
metrics.definition: Filtered cases with recorded all-time approval history / all filtered cases.
metrics.limitation: Counts review records, not necessarily completed human decisions; not an AI-correctness measure.

metrics.title: Autonomy indicator
metrics.definition: Completed filtered cases without recorded all-time approval history / completed filtered cases.
metrics.limitation: No recorded approval is not proof of safe AI autonomy; underlying completion provenance matters.

metrics.title: Exception rate
metrics.definition: Filtered cases currently in the exception stage / all filtered cases.
metrics.limitation: Current-state measure, not all historical exceptions or a fairness score.

metrics.title: AI request budgets
metrics.definition: Recorded inputBytes, output-token allowance and budget approval/rejection steps.
metrics.limitation: Conservative size bound and allowance, not actual tokens consumed, spend or response correctness.

metrics.title: Execution continuity
metrics.definition: Attempt status/timestamps, step codes and correlation/parent links.
metrics.limitation: An execution status is not case completion, SLA evidence or professional approval.

metrics.title: SLA and average resolution time
metrics.definition: The main Analytics summary shows insufficient data for these two measures.
metrics.limitation: Do not substitute current checklist state, estimates or simulated results for dated outcome evidence.

metrics.title: Answer correctness and unsupported claims
metrics.definition: Reviewed benchmark answers passing correctness/support criteria / eligible evaluated answers.
metrics.limitation: Requires approved ground truth, dataset coverage, versions and uncertainty reporting; no value claimed.

metrics.title: Appropriate abstention
metrics.definition: Correctly withheld answers / evaluated questions requiring abstention; also report unnecessary withholding.
metrics.limitation: The assistant has abstention outcomes, but an outcome is not an evaluated aggregate quality rate.

metrics.title: Fairness disparities
metrics.definition: Reviewed paired-case differences and lawful cohort outcomes where a permitted analysis exists.
metrics.limitation: Report sample sizes and context; do not collect real protected traits without separately approved purpose and safeguards.

metrics.title: Privacy leakage and recovery assurance
metrics.definition: Prohibited disclosures in scoped tests, protected-data coverage, verified recovery outcomes and latency with defined denominators.
metrics.limitation: Existing blocking/recovery controls are not a published leakage rate, recovery SLO or full assurance score.

roadmap.title: Consolidated compliance assurance
roadmap.scope: Map reviewed legal obligations to controls, owners and evidence; assemble consolidated gap-aware evidence packs and independent assessments.
roadmap.limitation: Existing governance review and audit records remain useful but are not certification.

roadmap.title: Expanded live authenticity coverage
roadmap.scope: Approve and validate selected issuer/provider adapters, source revocation and freshness coverage for required document types.
roadmap.limitation: Signed-result infrastructure is already present; commercial source coverage is configuration- and provider-dependent.

roadmap.title: Systematic answer-quality evaluation
roadmap.scope: Use business-reviewed synthetic questions and expected outcomes across policy dates, audiences, contradictory evidence and model changes.
roadmap.limitation: Broader benchmark work is underway separately; this pack does not claim it has shipped or publish an accuracy result.

roadmap.title: Fairness evaluation and challenge process
roadmap.scope: Introduce reviewed paired scenarios, governed disparity analysis and a dedicated independent challenge/appeal process for relevant AI-supported decisions.
roadmap.limitation: Fairness work is underway separately; human oversight does not establish bias-free decisions.

roadmap.title: Consolidated assurance reporting
roadmap.scope: Bring quality, privacy, control, provider and recovery evidence into defined reports with thresholds, denominators, owners and evidence dates.
roadmap.limitation: Existing operational counts and source records are not a completed responsible-AI scorecard.

deployment_evidence_not_verified.title: Identity-provider posture
deployment_evidence_not_verified.required_evidence: Tenant MFA, SSO, session settings and administrator recovery configuration.

deployment_evidence_not_verified.title: Encryption and key management
deployment_evidence_not_verified.required_evidence: Transport/storage coverage, key ownership and rotation, backup encryption and relevant provider contracts.

deployment_evidence_not_verified.title: Residency and international transfer
deployment_evidence_not_verified.required_evidence: Actual application, database, storage, AI and channel-provider locations and transfer arrangements.

deployment_evidence_not_verified.title: AI-provider data-use terms
deployment_evidence_not_verified.required_evidence: Training use, provider retention, subprocessors, deletion commitments and contractual restrictions.

deployment_evidence_not_verified.title: Incident response and independent security assessment
deployment_evidence_not_verified.required_evidence: SIEM integration, response ownership, vulnerability management and fresh independent penetration-test evidence.

deployment_evidence_not_verified.title: Recovery and compliance attestations
deployment_evidence_not_verified.required_evidence: Verified backup/restore scope, RTO/RPO evidence and any applicable external certifications. Existing audit-provider drills do not establish full service disaster recovery.
